name: MphasiS Limited
remarksWeb: We have intimated regarding Change of Control and the related change in our promoter vide our intimation dated 10 August 2021. As a result of the completion of the sale and purchase of shares pursuant to the Share Purchase Agreement, BCP Topco IX Pte. Ltd., (�Acquirer�), had acquired 104,799,577 Equity Shares, representing 55.97%, of the paid up Share Capital of the Company from Marble II Pte. Ltd. (�Outgoing Promoter�). Consequent to the Change of Control, the Acquirer had become the Promoter of the Company. In addition, the Acquirer had acquired 65 Equity Shares, from a public shareholder, under the Open Offer. The shareholding of the Acquirer post the acquisition and Open Offer is 104,799,642 equity shares of the Company.  Further, the Company on 13 September 2021, had submitted an application with the stock exchanges seeking approval for reclassification of Outgoing Promoter of the Company as public under Regulation 31A(10) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015, which is under progress with the stock exchanges. Marble II Pte. has ceased to be the Promoter of the Company pursuant to change of control.
revisionRemark: As requested by the stock exchange for processing the Promoter reclassification application.
